title: In Conversation: k0j0 on Phantasmagoric Stories and Interfaces
author: Amy Jiang
excerpt: A conversation with new media art duo k0j0 about interfaces, friction, and the stories that shape our relationship with AI.

body.text: Koi Ren and Joey Verbeke work together as k0j0, a new media art duo exploring the politics embedded in technological interfaces.
Their practice brings together research in human-computer interaction, artificial intelligence, media theory, and speculative design.
The full interview discusses phantasmagoria, AI as creative material, uncertainty, and the power structures that interfaces can reveal.
